title: Fresher
summary: Start your first full-time software engineering role by building small features and fixing bugs with support from more experienced teammates.
responsibilities: Implement and test well-defined changes to web applications.
Reproduce reported issues, document what you find, and submit changes for review.
requirements: Working knowledge of one programming language and basic web and SQL concepts.
Ability to use Git for basic tasks and explain how you debugged a problem.
A project from coursework, self-study, an internship, or open source that you can walk through. Professional experience is optional.
